proof_scope: In progress. R1789 proves an explicit initial density and squared-L2 radius gain. There is a threshold J0 such that, for every r>=5, one fixed rational free family of exactly 2^(3r) generators in the Frobenius ball of radius2^(-r), with inverses in the same ball and common denominator Q_r<=2^(1920r), works for all j>=max(J0,7680r) and all walk lengths ell>=floor(j/(3840r)). At smoothing radius eta=4^(-j), the actual one-sided Haar-smoothed density is everywhere at most eta^(-3+1/61440); its real square is integrable and has integral at most that same bound. J0 is independent of r. This is the initialization for flattening, not the final flatness bound.
